title: The Semantic Inquiry Graph
what_this_is: The vocabulary of HARNESS-002's semantic compilation: how a rich visual question and an abundant
provisional reading become atomic typed claims, the relations between them, and the observables that
would have to be produced for any of them to gain support.
It is DATA rather than code because the enums are the load-bearing part. A claim kind or a capability
class invented at a call site is indistinguishable from one somebody decided, and the compiler is a
model — the closed sets are exactly what it is not allowed to extend on its own.
not_this: Not the Perceptual Action Grammar (what act may be PROPOSED to a curator).
Not the Director's actuator vocabulary (what globally scoped operation has an EXECUTOR).
Not the agent organ vocabulary (what a body can perceive FROM ITS LOCUS).
A capability CLASS is a fourth thing again: what KIND of instrument a claim would need. It names no
implementation on purpose, so that the broker — not the compiler — chooses one, and so that a class
with no instrument today is a visible gap rather than an unfilled tool name.

claim_kinds.entity: A thing the reading says is present. The only kind a segmenter can even be asked about.
claim_kinds.attribute: A property OF something — its scale, its density, its finish.
claim_kinds.spatial_relation: Two things and where they stand to each other.
claim_kinds.topology: Connectedness, enclosure, containment, holes — relations that survive deformation.
claim_kinds.pattern_or_sequence: A repetition or an ordering; the recurrence is the claim, not any one member.
claim_kinds.field: A continuous quantity spread over the picture rather than located in one thing.
claim_kinds.hierarchy: A part/whole or dominance ordering across several things.
claim_kinds.comparison: A statement that holds ACROSS images. Needs more than one image by construction.
claim_kinds.historical_or_sourced: A claim whose warrant is outside the picture. Never settled by looking.
claim_kinds.causal_hypothesis: A because. The consequences may be observable; the link itself is not.
claim_kinds.interpretation: A reading ABOUT the picture. Not a weak measurement — a different kind of claim.
claim_kinds.generative_rule: A rule for making something that does not exist. Imagined by construction.
claim_kinds.unknown: The compiler could not type it. LEGAL and VISIBLE — see the law of the same name.

extent.asks_for: where a named thing is, as an extent on the image

geometry.asks_for: a computed relation between extents — containment, adjacency, centrality, alignment

topology.asks_for: connectedness, enclosure, holes; relations that survive deformation

pattern.asks_for: recurrence, spacing, rhythm, ordering across the frame

scalar_field.asks_for: a continuous per-pixel quantity — density, pressure, luminance

vector_field.asks_for: a continuous per-pixel direction — flow, orientation, surface normal

semantic_reading.asks_for: a sentence about the picture, produced by a thinker
semantic_reading.never_settles: a measurable demand. A reading is not evidence in the picture.

external_source.asks_for: a citation from outside the picture
external_source.never_settles: a measurable demand. Nothing measured in the frame can stand in for a source.

ground_forms.frame: the whole image, as the thing being spoken about
ground_forms.field: a continuous quantity over an image
ground_forms.path: an ordered traversal — a direction, a sequence, a trajectory
ground_forms.relation: a named link between two grounds

historical_or_sourced.why: its warrant lies outside the picture. `epistemics.py` walls `sourced` for this reason; the same wall is applied one level up, on the claim, before any instrument is chosen.

interpretation.why: an interpretation does not become measurable because measurements contribute to it. That promotion is the single failure HARNESS-001A's semantic remainder exists to prevent.

causal_hypothesis.why: the CONSEQUENCES of a because may be observable and should be emitted as observables on separate claims. The link itself is not something an instrument returns.

generative_rule.why: a rule for making what does not exist has nothing to measure and nothing to cite. HARNESS-001B declined to give `imagined` an EpistemicStatus for exactly this reason.

comparison.why: a comparison across images is not available from one image. Typed from one, it would be a corpus tendency asserted from a single observation.

id_rule: Every id is sha256 over the inquiry id, the object's kind, and the object's STABLE CONTENT,
truncated to 12 hex characters and prefixed. Nothing is minted from a clock or a counter.
Replaying a frozen model output must produce the same graph byte for byte, and an id derived
from list position would silently renumber the moment a model reordered its own output.
forbidden_geometry_why: A scene theorist reads pixels and is still a thinker: it may say a thing is there and may not say
WHERE, in numbers. The moment a reading can carry a box, its output is a measurement nobody measured
and every downstream consumer that checks provenance will find a legitimate-looking one.

laws.message: a scene reading or a compiled claim may not carry a geometry, region, mark or confidence key
laws.why: the strongest thing a thinker may produce is `interpretive`. Geometry is what an organ produces.

laws.message: a claim may not start as `visible` or `measured`
laws.why: nothing has run. A compiler that could mint a measured claim would make the whole evidence layer decorative.

laws.message: a claim carries at least one source pointer, or declares source_type `compiler_inference`
laws.why: an unanchored claim is one nobody said and nothing produced. It reads exactly like the others.

laws.message: a `compiler_inference` claim names the claims it was inferred from
laws.why: an inference with no parents is an assertion wearing an inference's clothes.

laws.message: a term recorded as semantic remainder may not also carry a `measurable` demand
laws.why: HARNESS-001A's rule, applied to the graph. A remainder is what measurement does not reach.

laws.message: an observable serving a `historical_or_sourced` claim must request `external_source`
laws.why: a historical generalization routed to an image capability becomes an image measurement of a claim the image cannot settle.

laws.message: a `comparison` claim may not be scoped to `one_image`
laws.why: one observation typed as a corpus tendency is the cheapest way to manufacture a finding.

laws.message: `unknown` is a claim kind, and an unoperationalizable claim is retained
laws.why: dropping what could not be typed makes the graph look more complete than the reading was.

laws.message: a claim kind, capability class, ground form or edge kind outside the closed sets is refused BY NAME
laws.why: how often a model invents a capability is the observable that says whether to trust it. Silently dropped, it is unobservable.

laws.message: an unavailable or unparseable model produces an empty graph carrying a refusal, never a canned result
laws.why: a plausible default is indistinguishable from a real reading and would be believed.

laws.message: the graph carries the user's prompt byte for byte
laws.why: every refusal downstream is only checkable against what was actually asked.

no_topic_branch: No production module reading this contract may name a topic. There is no fold branch, no sculpture
branch, no architecture branch, and no botany branch. Subjects, predicates, targets and descriptions
are open strings; the closed sets above are shapes, not subjects.
`test_semantic_compilation_generality.py` scans the production sources for the fixtures' topic nouns
and fails by name if one appears.
